messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick pitch we should run a compact "Lightning Lane" marketing push: 3 bite-sized dev tutorials, a short micro-benchmark post, and one live workshop. audience: OSS maintainers and early-stage product teams.
Evan (DevRel): yes please. recommend micro tutorials: 1) quickstart (5m), 2) cost & batching tips (6m), 3) rollout + canary (6m). workshop = 45m with guided lab.
Jonas (Eng): for bench we can do a fast reproducible script: single-GPU run, ~500 synthetic prompts, compare rw-compact-8b q8 vs a baseline. metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost/1k tokens. keep scripts under 10m runtime.
Priya (Growth): routing idea: landing page -> form with project-type dropdown and a hidden bench_interest flag if they click "see benchmark". tag leads and start a special drip for bench-interested folks. route larger estimated usage (>50k tokens/mo) to AE.
Alex (Content): messaging: headline: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and clear unit economics" subhead: "Lightweight tutorials + micro-bench to get you production-ready in a day." social card: bench highlight once bench done.
Maya (Marketing): social card copy draft: "Lightning Lane: <60ms p50 on sample refkit — 3x cost vs naive baseline" (placeholder until verified). keep claims guarded.
Evan (DevRel): we need a `make bench-lightning` target in refkit repo so others can reproduce. will coordinate a small README.
Jonas (Eng): Ill add the make target and a minimal dataset generator. ETA 4 business days. will also add a config for G5/q8 runs.
Priya (Growth): UTMs: utm_source=lightning_lane, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=refkit_q2. HubSpot rules: if campaign=="lightning_lane" and bench_interest==true then add_tag("bench-interested"), enroll drip, and if tokens_estimate>=50000 assign to AE.
Alex (Content): CTA copy options:
- "Try the Lightning Lane demo"
- "See the micro-benchmark"
- "Join the live workshop"
Keep them short and explicit.
Maya (Marketing): timeline proposal: Week 0: write tutorials + run bench. Week 1: post + social + open signups. Week 2: webinar + follow-up drip.
Evan (DevRel): workshop plan: 10m demo, 25m guided lab, 10m Q&A. deck + short demo script.
Jonas (Eng): bench details: dataset=500 prompts (mix short/long), models=rw-compact-8b q8 vs opensource-8b fp16, infra=g5.xlarge, metrics=p50/p95/throughput/cost. will commit script to https://github.com/redwood/refkit-lightning.
Priya (Growth): measurement: signups, RSVPs, repo stars, MQLs. set a small KPI: 200 signups, 50 RSVPs, 10 MQLs in first month.
Maya (Marketing): legal review needed for benchmark claims. Evan please loop in Legal before we publish numbers.
Evan (DevRel): will ping legal and add a note in the bench README about how we measured and environment reproducibility.
deploy-bot: staging preview for landing page scheduled 2026-03-24T10:30Z :white_check_mark:
Maya (Marketing): short todo list:
- Alex: publish 3 tutorial drafts by Tue
- Jonas: bench script + `make bench-lightning` by Thu
- Evan: legal + workshop deck by Thu
- Priya: HubSpot routing + UTMs by Thu
- Maya: landing page + social cards by Fri
Maya (Marketing): syncing Friday 9am PT to review landing page. any blockers?
Jonas (Eng): might need an extra GPU slot to run bench reliably during peak hours.
Evan (DevRel): no blockers from my side.
Priya (Growth): will draft email drip once Alex drops benchmark copy.
Alex (Content): I'll drop first drafts tomorrow morning.
Maya (Marketing): great thanks team :sparkles:
